messages.app.setup.help.ios.text: Location: Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services; also check Location in Safari’s settings for this website. Alerts: Settings → Notifications → MyScoutee → Allow Notifications. Open MyScoutee from the Home Screen and retry.

messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-connectio: Check the client name, last use and expiry to recognize active access. An expired permission must be renewed before the client can use it again.

messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-client-ac: Set this client independently. Its effective access is the lower of this choice and the main MCP setting.

messages.guide.profile.integration-access.integra: Choose Blocked, Write, Read or Full. Read includes permitted queries and writes; Full allows every supported operation within your existing permissions.
Read the description before confirming. Access levels never grant permissions that the profile itself does not have.

messages.guide.profile.integration-access.close.d: Close without confirming to keep the parent draft unchanged.
messages.guide.profile.integration-help.integrati: The main MCP link starts Blocked. Open its shield, choose a pack, confirm, then save with the tick in the integration window. Client generation stays separate.

A connection acts only with the account’s existing permissions. It cannot gain an administrator or operator role through an access level.
Generate creates a client ID and a one-time secret. Copy them into your client’s settings, never into chat.
messages.guide.profile.integration-help.close.des: Return to connection settings. Reading this help does not save a permission change.

Check the profile shown here. This is the account that the approved client will act for.
The displayed level limits this connection. The main MCP limit and the client’s limit both apply.
Approve grants this client the displayed access for this profile. Cancel returns without granting access. You can revoke a granted connection later under API / MCP.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-authorization.close.de: Close the authorization request without granting access. When a client request is active, closing sends the refusal back to that client.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-advanced.mcp-client-id: Copy this identifier when the client’s setup asks for a client ID. It identifies this credential.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-advanced.mcp-client-ac: Set the access pack for this client. The tick stages the change; save it with the tick in the parent API / MCP window. The main MCP limit still applies.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-advanced.mcp-client-se: Copy the new secret now into the client’s secure setup. The complete value is shown only after generation.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-advanced.mcp-manual-ke: Use this section only when your AI client asks for manual credentials. Ordinary OAuth connections are listed in the parent window.
Generate a client key with the existing Write default. Creation happens immediately; copy the secret before closing. You may then stage a different access pack.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-advanced.mcp-client-re: Remove this client after confirming the dialog. It will no longer be able to authenticate with these credentials.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-advanced.close.descrip: Return to API / MCP settings. Generated or revoked credentials have already changed; staged access-pack edits still require the save tick in the parent window.
Copy this identifier when the client’s setup asks for a client ID. It identifies this credential.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-details.mcp-client-acc: Set the access pack for this client. The tick stages the change; save it with the tick in the parent API / MCP window. The main MCP limit still applies.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-details.mcp-client-sec: Copy the new secret now into the client’s secure setup. The complete value is shown only after generation.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-details.mcp-client-cal: This is the return address registered by the AI client for authorization. It is a technical connection detail, not the MCP address to add to your client.
messages.guide.profile.mcp-details.close.descript: Return from this client’s details without saving the parent API / MCP form. If you staged an access-pack change, use the parent window’s save tick to persist it.

messages.operator.configuration.admin.emails.desc: Separate addresses with commas or line breaks. Up to 32 addresses; leave empty to disable dedicated-email administrator access.
messages.operator.configuration.credential.regist: Registered — enter a value to rotate
messages.operator.configuration.social.empty: No public social site is configured. Add one when this deployment has a public community destination.
messages.operator.configuration.admin.guidance: These addresses authorize administrator access for this deployment. Each person uses the existing email login or create-account flow to sign in or set a password in the operator's configured Firebase project. Java stores the authorized address, not the person's password; changes take effect on the next sign-in or token refresh and are never embedded in the package.
messages.guide.operator.configuration.operator-sa: Save the name and logo used by this deployment. This saves the shared configuration draft, including pending edits in its other sections; the updated branding is then applied in the app.
Save the email list that grants app-administration access. Check additions and removals carefully; this also saves other pending changes in the shared configuration draft.
Save the data controller’s name and privacy contact email shown in the app’s privacy information. Other pending edits in the shared configuration draft are saved with them.

Save the Firebase configuration, then run its authentication and messaging checks before activation. Saving credentials and activating them are separate actions; other shared configuration edits are also saved.
messages.guide.operator.configuration.close.descr: Return to the operator page. Use the relevant save action before closing if you want to persist pending configuration changes.
messages.guide.operator.configuration.operator-sa: Save the public API address used by clients. This also saves other pending edits in the shared configuration draft.
Save the links shown on the landing page. This also saves other pending edits in the shared configuration draft.
messages.operator.configuration.tls.enabled: Turn HTTPS configuration on or off
messages.operator.configuration.tls.guidance: Point this domain at the deployment before applying automatic certificates. Saving may briefly restart the web gateway.
messages.operator.configuration.tls.private.key.p: Paste an unencrypted PEM private key
messages.operator.configuration.tls.credential.co: A certificate and private key are already installed
messages.operator.configuration.tls.test.domain.s: The domain and ACME path are reachable.
messages.operator.configuration.tls.test.certific: The certificate, private key, and domain match.
messages.operator.configuration.tls.validation.in: Complete the HTTPS fields before testing or saving.
messages.operator.configuration.tls.domain.invali: Enter a valid public DNS domain.
messages.operator.configuration.tls.certificate.r: Provide both the certificate chain and private key.
messages.operator.configuration.tls.backend.unava: This deployment does not expose managed HTTPS controls.
messages.guide.operator.configuration.operator-sa: Submit the selected TLS mode, domain and certificate settings. Follow the returned job state to confirm completion; a save request alone does not prove the new certificate is already active.
messages.notification.kind.release-available.mess: Version {releaseVersion} is available. Review it before installing.
messages.operator.update.subtitle: Check and update this deployment
messages.operator.update.error.rollback.unavailab: The previous verified package is unavailable. Check the release source before retrying.
messages.operator.update.error.check: Could not check for updates. Please try again.
messages.operator.update.error.start: Could not confirm the update request. Check its status before trying again.
messages.operator.update.error.status: Could not read update progress. Check the deployment status before trying again.
messages.operator.update.error.status.timeout: Timed out waiting for update progress. The update may still be running. Reopen Updates to check its status.
messages.operator.update.error.recovery.required: The update stopped in an uncertain state. Follow the recovery procedure before retrying.
messages.operator.update.error.unavailable: No verified deployment update is available.
messages.operator.update.error.response: The deployment update response is invalid.
messages.operator.update.error.metadata: This release has no signed update information yet.
messages.operator.update.error.key: The trusted update signing key is not configured.
messages.guide.operator.updates.overview.label: Updates
messages.guide.operator.updates.overview.descript: Check the installed version, offered release and rollback target before acting. During an update this window shows the current phase, progress and any failure.
messages.guide.operator.updates.operator-refresh-: Fetch the latest release information and update state. This checks what is available; installation starts only with the update action.
messages.guide.operator.updates.operator-apply-up: Start installing the offered release on this deployment. Follow its progress here; after successful completion the application reloads to use the installed version.
messages.guide.operator.updates.operator-rollback: Start the supported rollback to the displayed target version. Check that target first; a successful rollback reloads the application just like an update.
messages.guide.operator.updates.close.description: Close the progress window and return to the operator page. Closing this window does not cancel an update already started.
messages.feedback.submitted.category.success: Feedback sent successfully in "{category}". Thank you for helping improve MyScoutee.
messages.admin.feedback.empty.title: No feedback
messages.admin.feedback.empty.description: No application feedback has been submitted.
messages.admin.reports.empty.title: No reports
messages.admin.reports.empty.description: No moderation reports are waiting for review.
messages.admin.feedback.confirm.mark.solved.title: Would you like to mark this feedback as resolved?
messages.admin.feedback.confirm.mark.solved.messa: {user} will receive a support message saying the feedback was reviewed.
messages.admin.feedback.confirm.mark.unresolved.t: Would you like to mark this feedback as unresolved?
messages.admin.feedback.confirm.mark.unresolved.m: The feedback will return to the unresolved list.
messages.admin.reports.confirm.mark.solved.title: Would you like to mark this report as resolved?
messages.admin.reports.confirm.mark.solved.messag: {user} will receive a support message saying the report was reviewed.
messages.admin.reports.confirm.mark.unresolved.ti: Would you like to mark this report as unresolved?
messages.admin.reports.confirm.mark.unresolved.me: The report will return to the unresolved list.
messages.admin.reports.confirm.block.title: Block {user}?
messages.admin.reports.confirm.block.message: The user will be blocked and a support chat message will be sent.
messages.admin.reports.confirm.unblock.title: Unblock {user}?
messages.admin.reports.confirm.unblock.message: The user profile status will be restored and they can use MyScoutee again.
messages.guide.admin.reports.overview.label: Reports
messages.guide.admin.reports.overview.description: Open a report to read its reason, affected user and source context. Use the user’s action menu for a warning or restriction after reviewing the evidence; opening a report alone does not take that action.
messages.guide.admin.reports.reports-review-statu: Switch between unresolved reports that need attention and resolved reports you want to revisit. This selects the queue; it does not change a report’s review state.
messages.guide.admin.reports.blocked-users.label: Blocked accounts
messages.guide.admin.reports.blocked-users.descri: Open the restricted-user list to inspect existing blocks. A user’s menu offers unblocking and, when a support conversation already exists, access to that conversation.
messages.guide.admin.report-detail.overview.label: Review report
messages.guide.admin.report-detail.overview.descr: Read the report’s reason and linked context alongside the reported user. Review the source before using the available warning or block action; the action applies to that user.
messages.guide.admin.feedback.overview.label: Feedback
messages.guide.admin.feedback.overview.descriptio: Read submitted bug reports, requests and other feedback. After handling an item, use its row menu to mark it solved; a solved item can be returned to unresolved when further work is needed.
messages.guide.admin.feedback.feedback-review-sta: Choose unresolved feedback for current work or solved feedback for follow-up. Marking an item solved changes which queue contains it; it does not delete the submission.
messages.guide.admin.feedback-detail.overview.des: Read the full submission and its category before deciding whether it has been handled. Return to the feedback list to use the row’s solved or unresolved action.
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.overview.label: Chat review
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.overview.descrip: Review the selected user and report context before composing a warning. Sending records a moderation warning for that user; it is an action, not a private draft note.
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.message.label: Warning text
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.message.descript: Write the warning the selected user will receive: identify the reported conduct and explain what needs to change. Check the recipient and wording before sending.
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.send-warning.des: Send the written warning to the selected user, linked to the selected report when present. Wait for the success message; after a successful send the text field is cleared.
messages.Reports can only be started from a chat: Reports can only be started from a chat message you can view.
messages.operator.email.title: Email delivery
messages.operator.email.credentialKept: Configured — leave blank to keep the saved key
messages.operator.email.purpose: Warns deleted-account owners five days before permanent deletion. The lead time is fixed.
messages.operator.email.backendRequired: Email configuration requires the connected backend. No credentials are stored in the browser demo.
messages.operator.email.notConfigured: Email provider is not configured or is disabled.
messages.operator.email.failed: Unable to load or save email configuration. Check the fields or reload after another operator’s change.
messages.operator.email.invalid: Check the provider, sender email and API key.
messages.operator.email.changed: Email configuration changed. Reload and retry.
messages.admin.jobs.rule.account.deletion.warning: Emails deleted-account owners five days before permanent deletion using the operator’s email provider.
messages.account.deletion.warning.subject: Your account is approaching permanent deletion
messages.account.deletion.warning.body:
Hello {{name}},

Your deleted account is scheduled for permanent deletion on {{purgeAt}}. This is your five-day reminder. If you want to keep your account, restore it in the application before that date.
messages.account.deletion.warning.failed: Some account deletion warnings could not be delivered.
messages.email.unsubscribe.title: Email preferences
messages.email.unsubscribe.confirm: Would you like to stop receiving emails from this service?
messages.email.unsubscribe.success: You have unsubscribed. You will no longer receive emails from this service.
messages.email.unsubscribe.invalid: This unsubscribe link is invalid. Please use the link in your email.
messages.email.unsubscribe.error: We could not update your email preferences. Please try again.
messages.email.unsubscribe.javascript: Please enable JavaScript to confirm your email preferences.
messages.chat.call.direct.help: Audio and video go directly between participants. Everyone must open this chat to receive or join the call.
messages.chat.call.speaker: Mute or unmute incoming audio
messages.chat.call.verify.help: Compare this code with every participant through a trusted channel. It changes when someone joins or leaves. Matching codes verify the call keys; they do not verify who owns a browser.
messages.chat.call.error.browser: Calls require HTTPS or localhost and a browser supporting WebRTC.
messages.chat.call.error.node: The selected connection discovery node is unavailable.
messages.chat.call.error.media: Allow camera or microphone access and check that the device is available.
messages.chat.call.error.signaling: Call coordination is unavailable. You can leave and try joining again.
messages.chat.call.error.direct: A direct connection could not be established with a participant. Check the network or firewall. Media is never relayed through the server.
messages.chat.call.error.secure: A secure connection could not be established with a participant. Leave and join again.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-participants.label: Participants
messages.guide.chat.call.call-participants.descri: Each tile belongs to one participant. Swipe or use the arrows for more people. Offscreen video pauses while their audio continues.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-follow-speakers.des: Turn this on to keep the current and most recent speakers visible. Turn it off to choose a page yourself.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-self-mute.label: Your microphone
messages.guide.chat.call.call-self-mute.descripti: Mute or restore your microphone here or with the bottom microphone button. Red means muted. An admin mute must first be released by an admin.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-self-camera.label: Your camera
messages.guide.chat.call.call-self-camera.descrip: Switch your own camera on or off. This matches the bottom camera button and the camera in your volume block. Audio can stay on.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-peer-mute.label: Mute one person for yourself
messages.guide.chat.call.call-peer-mute.descripti: Mute this participant only on your device. Others still hear them. Their volume-panel mute controls the same setting.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-peer-video.label: Receive this video
messages.guide.chat.call.call-peer-video.descript: Stop or restore video from this participant to save bandwidth. Audio continues. This matches their camera control in the volume panel.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-admin-mute.label: Mute for everyone
messages.guide.chat.call.call-admin-mute.descript: As an admin, mute this participant for the whole call. Releasing the restriction lets them switch their own microphone back on; it does not turn it on for them.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-zoom.label: Enlarge a participant
messages.guide.chat.call.call-zoom.description: Show one tile at full size. Press again to return to the grid. Other participants remain audible.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-spectrum.label: Speech activity
messages.guide.chat.call.call-spectrum.descriptio: The bars show the microphone sound level across frequencies. The green microphone and frame show speech; a red crossed microphone means muted.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-accept.label: Join with audio
messages.guide.chat.call.call-accept.description: Join this call with your microphone. Your camera starts off and can be enabled later.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-decline.label: Decline the call
messages.guide.chat.call.call-decline.description: Decline this invitation without starting your microphone or camera. The chat remains available.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-microphone.label: Microphone on or off
messages.guide.chat.call.call-microphone.descript: Choose whether others can hear you. This does not mute incoming sound. The red button and your tile show when you are muted.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-camera.label: Camera on or off
messages.guide.chat.call.call-camera.description: Choose whether to send your camera picture. You can keep talking with the camera off.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-volume.label: Volume and received video
messages.guide.chat.call.call-volume.description: Open playback volume and individual participant controls. Each named block lets you adjust sound or stop receiving that person’s video.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-play-audio.label: Allow audio playback
messages.guide.chat.call.call-play-audio.descript: Your browser paused incoming audio. Press this button to allow playback on this device.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-hangup.label: Leave the call
messages.guide.chat.call.call-hangup.description: Leave the call and release your microphone and camera. The chat stays open and the others can continue talking.
messages.guide.chat.call.close.label: Close and leave
messages.guide.chat.call.close.description: Closing this call window also leaves the call. Closing only the explanation guide does not leave it.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.master-volume.des: The Me slider controls all incoming sound on this device. It does not change your microphone or what others hear.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.master-mute.label: Mute incoming sound
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.master-mute.descr: Mute all incoming audio on this device. Unmute to return to the previous volume. The outer volume button turns red while muted.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.self-camera.label: Your camera
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.self-camera.descr: This switches your own camera, just like the bottom camera button and the icon on your tile. It does not switch everyone’s video.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-volume.label: This person’s volume
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-volume.descr: Adjust the participant named above this slider. The setting combines with your overall playback volume and does not affect other listeners.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-mute.label: Mute this person
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-mute.descrip: Mute only this participant on your device. Unmuting keeps their previous volume. Their tile microphone shows the same setting.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-video.label: This person’s video
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-video.descri: Stop or allow their video on your device; their audio stays on. Allowing it resumes video when their tile is visible.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.close.label: Close the volume panel
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.close.description: Return to the call with your settings kept. Closing this panel does not leave the call.
messages.guide.template.chat.chat-call.label: Audio and video call
messages.guide.template.chat.chat-call.descriptio: Start a call with the people in this conversation. They must open the same chat to join. Use the camera control to enable video. Calls require a backend connection.
messages.guide.template.chat.chat-pins.label: Pinned messages
messages.guide.template.chat.chat-pins.descriptio: Open the pinned messages in the loaded conversation. Select one to return to it. Pin or unpin a message from its message menu.
messages.operator.action.updates.detail: Update this deployment at any time
messages.logout.question: Are you sure you want to log out?
messages.guide.landing.guide.guide-launcher.label: Help when you need it
messages.guide.landing.guide.guide-launcher.descr: Help: Next, Back, Done. Drag the lightbulb or notification bell; drop on the red X to hide. Turn help off or back on permanently: side menu → Explanations.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-status.trig: Choose who can see this profile. Visibility affects discovery and profile access, while saved profile details remain unchanged.
messages.guide.common.close.label: Close this popup
messages.guide.common.close.description: Close this popup when you are done here. The guide ends with this screen, while the parent view stays open if the app keeps it underneath.
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-upload.label: Fill an empty photo slot
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-upload.descri: Choose a file from your device for this empty slot. Wait for upload to finish; uploading a file does not save the whole profile or publish a feed post.
messages.guide.profile.editor.api-integration.des: Open your API keys and AI-client connections through MCP. Admin accounts open their management API settings here.
messages.guide.chats.chat-actions.label: Message actions
messages.guide.chats.chat-actions.description: Open a message menu to reply, react, or use other available actions. These controls apply to one message, keeping the rest of the conversation unchanged.
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-replace.label: Replace a selected photo
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-replace.descr: A filled slot first selects its photo. Click the selected slot again to choose a replacement; check the new preview before saving the parent editor.
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-preview.label: Inspect the selected photo
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-preview.descr: The large preview shows the selected photo. Selecting another filled slot changes this preview; selecting it again opens replacement.
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-remove.label: Remove this photo from the draft
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-remove.descri: Removes this photo from the edited collection. Review the remaining images before saving the parent profile, event, asset or post.
messages.guide.chats.chat-compose.label: Write a message
messages.guide.chats.chat-compose.description: Enter your message here and send it to the open conversation. Replies, shared items, and any selected context stay attached to this chat.
messages.guide.chats.chat-send.label: Send message
messages.guide.chats.chat-send.description: Send the text you have written to the current conversation. Check the recipient and context first, since sending makes the message visible to its participants.
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-pages.label: Find additional photo slots
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-pages.descrip: The dots move between pages of photo slots. This only changes which slots are visible; it does not reorder or remove images.
messages.guide.chats.chat-call.label: Start or join a call
messages.guide.chats.chat-call.description: The green phone opens an audio call immediately. Turn on your camera inside the call if you want. A red crossed phone means calling is unavailable.
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-members.label: Conversation members
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-members.descriptio: Open participant details to see who can take part in this conversation. Membership context helps you understand who will receive shared updates.
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-copy.label: Copy the image address
messages.guide.profile.editor.image-copy.descript: Copies the image link to the clipboard. It does not duplicate the photo into another slot or save your profile.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile.photo.label: Manage your profile photos
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile.photo.descr: The pencil opens your photo slots for upload, replacement and removal. Closing that popup returns to the draft; Save profile persists the changes.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-save.label: Save profile changes
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-save.descri: Save your edits when the sections are ready. The updated information is then used by your profile view and the surfaces where others discover you.
messages.guide.profile.editor.about.label: About you
messages.guide.profile.editor.about.description: Write a short introduction. This text helps people understand who you are before meeting you.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-name.label: Profile basics
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-name.descri: Review your name and core profile details so people can recognize you. Accurate information makes your profile and event introductions clearer.
